context: Oversized file and blank AskUserQuestion answers

checklist.name: Detects blank answers
checklist.description: Checks the answers after the call and recognises the empty result as the known tool bug

checklist.name: Numbered fallback
checklist.description: Prints the options as a numbered text list and waits for the user's reply instead of assuming priorities

checklist.name: Sub-agent for large file
checklist.description: Delegates the 40K-token file to the summarize-for-context sub-agent rather than reading it whole

checklist.name: Summary size and action
checklist.description: Produces a summary of about 500 tokens and records action summarized in the manifest

checklist.name: Baseline stays in budget
checklist.description: Does not inline the specification and keeps the baseline within 2000 tokens
